title: Meta’s $25 billion legal loss just put blood in the water
summary: When attorneys general from across the US announced a $17 billion settlement with Meta this summer, the sum was unprecedented. But a ruling last week by a New Mexico judge blew that number out of the water. The judge ordered Meta to pay $25 billion to resolve claims that Meta misled users around the 2018 […]
llm_summary: Meta faces a staggering $25 billion legal judgment after a New Mexico judge ruled the company must pay that amount to settle claims it misled users about the 2018 Cambridge Analytica data breach. The verdict dwarfs the $17 billion settlement previously announced by state attorneys general, marking the largest penalty ever levied on a tech firm for privacy violations. This massive loss could have far‑reaching effects on Meta’s finances
